decisions.reason: It still has its own page in 2024, fits the firm's platform-expansion direction, and prior visible investment makes management likely to continue backing it rather than treat any weak uptake as final.

Although it was downgraded from a standalone page to a website mention, it remains close to the core offer, so sunk development effort and the tendency to justify the 2023 launch still favor keeping it for now.

Its move from a standalone page to a mention suggests lower commercial emphasis, but as a tool building on the established offer and supporting integrated workflows it is still strategically easier for management to retain than to withdraw.
